examples.title: Some Examples
examples.example3: "蟹 + (Select All) Grade" uses Xie rime group grades 1, 2, 3, 4 for analysis ("-" means match all, Middle Chinese category required after "-")
examples.example4: "次浊 + (Select All) Tone" uses voiced aspirated initials + level, rising, departing, entering tones for analysis.
examples.example5: "宕 江" uses merged Dang and Jiang rime groups for analysis (space means analyze together, Enter means treat as different features)
examples.example6: "庄組" uses Zhuang group for analysis (if only "庄" is entered, Zhuang initial will be used).
examples.example7: "流開一" uses Liu rime group open mouth grade 1 characters for analysis.
examples.example8: "假 + 知組 章組" uses Jia rime group's Zhi and Zhang groups for analysis.
examples.example10: "(Select All) Place" analyzes all articulation places, including "labiodental, glottal, retroflex, palatal, velar, bilabial, dental".

help.title: Direct Input Guide

rules.rule1: Separate position tokens with spaces. Each token represents one query combination.
rules.rule2: Values that appear in only one category (e.g., "泥" only in "母") do not need a suffix.
rules.rule3: Values appearing in multiple categories (e.g., "山" in both "攝" and "韻") MUST have a category suffix (e.g., "山攝" or "山韻").
rules.rule4: The "-" prefix means "all values from this category" (e.g., "-等" matches all grade values; "蟹-等" matches 蟹攝 with all grades).
rules.rule5: Freely combine multiple query tokens (e.g., "蟹-等 知組" queries 蟹攝 with all grades AND 知組).
rules.rule6: Compounds like "流開一" are parsed character by character.

examples.title: Examples
examples.example2: "蟹-等" → Analyze with 蟹攝 divisions I, II, III, IV
examples.example3: "次濁-調" → Analyze with 次濁 initial + all tones
examples.example4: "庄組" → Analyze with 庄組 (entering just "庄" defaults to 庄母)
examples.example5: "流開一" → Analyze with 流攝開口一等
examples.example6: "塞擦" → Extract 塞擦音 for analysis
examples.example7: "-部位" → Analyze all places of articulation
examples.example8: "山攝 知組" → Analyze with 山攝 + 知組
